prayers.name: Frothing Mucus
prayers.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the **Charge (+1 Damage)** weapon ability has no effect on combat attacks that target the target. If the chanting roll was 6+, weapon abilities other than the **Companion** weapon ability have no effect instead.
prayers.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

prayers.name: Infectious Surge
prayers.effect: Add 2" to the target’s Move characteristic for the rest of the turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, for the rest of the turn, the target can use **^^Charge^^** abilities even if it used a **^^Retreat^^** ability in the same turn.
prayers.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle^^** unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

prayers.name: Agonising Vomiting
prayers.effect: Roll 7 dice. If the chanting roll was 6+, add 2 to each roll. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
prayers.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Maggotkin of Nurgle Priest^^** to chant this prayer, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
